description: This file contains unit tests for the CyclicBuffer class within the WPEFramework Core namespace. It includes tests for creation, access permissions, read/write operations, locking mechanisms, and inter-process sharing features, utilizing Google Test framework and system calls.

classes.name: CyclicBufferTest
classes.description: A derived class from CyclicBuffer used for testing purposes, overriding GetOverwriteSize method.

classes.name: ThreadLock
classes.description: A helper thread class to test locking and unlocking mechanisms of CyclicBuffer.

methods.name: ResetFileMask
methods.description: Resets the file creation mask to zero and returns the previous mask.

methods.name: RestoreFileMask
methods.description: Restores the file creation mask to a given value.

methods.name: IsValidFilePermissions
methods.description: Validates the file permissions against expected mode.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a file.

methods.name: GetCurrentTime
methods.description: Returns the current system time as timespec.

methods.name: CreateTimeOut
methods.description: Creates a timeout timespec based on wait time.

methods.name: CheckTimeOutIsExpired
methods.description: Checks if a timeout has expired.

methods.name: CheckBufferIsSharable
methods.description: Checks if a CyclicBuffer instance is sharable.

methods.name: SetSharePermissionsFromClonedProcess
methods.description: Creates a cloned process to set share permissions on a buffer.

methods.name: TestSharePermissionsFromDifferentProcess
methods.description: Tests buffer sharing permissions across processes.

methods.name: SetSharePermissionsFromForkedProcessAndVerify
methods.description: Sets share permissions from a forked process and verifies the buffer behavior.
